div.note: K is the Quadripartitus Latin (as in the sheet's layout); Liebermann's base Old English text is B (CCCC 383 f. 1, c. 1125); the Consiliatio Cnuti, Appendix, is in AF. Liebermann dates it 946–c. 961 and tentatively assigns it to Edgar (‘I Eadgar?’). B's heading is in black in the same line as the text; it stood in the archetype.
